note: The Night Before's storyboard for generated frames (CAMP.md). Takes as in boards/ford.json. The sky shot and the Thread across the sky are code; every take's sky is left plain so the engine can draw the Thread into it.
style: Hand-drawn fantasy illustration in the manner of a Renaissance sketchbook: fine sepia ink linework, one confident thicker contour around each figure, flat watercolour washes. Night: deep violet-blue shadows, and the campfire the only warm light, orange on the sides of things that face it and on the ground round it, long shadows thrown away from it. A plain dark night sky with a few stars and no moon. 2D hand-drawn anime animation, slow and still, with small living movements. No text, no logo, no border.

edric.text: Edric: a young swordsman, shaggy DARK CHESTNUT-BROWN hair (not red, not auburn), square jaw, heavy straight brows, deep-set tired eyes, a nose broken once, a deep teal cloak, one steel pauldron, worn leather; he sits ON THE GROUND (no rock, no seat), one knee drawn up, a plain longsword across it.

sera.text: Sera: a young seer, long wavy crimson hair, a long oval face, heavy-lidded eyes, a purple robe with a gold cross; she sits on a folded striped blanket hugging her knees.

kira.text: Kira: a scout with a white ponytail, a long narrow face, narrow hooded eyes, a crimson coat; Kira sits on a wooden crate with a map on one knee.

keyLegend: Each person rests their weight on what they sit on (see their description), with a small dark contact shadow where they touch it; the fire throws each person's long shadow away from it across the ground.
keyPlace: The place is the army's camp of the last reference image at night: peaked ochre canvas tents, a palisade, crates and barrels, a spear tripod, trampled grass; the campfire in a ring of stones.
physics: everyone stays seated exactly where they sit, their weight on the ground, the blanket or the crate; nobody floats or slides; when Edric stands, he pushes off the ground with his hand and his feet stay planted.

takes.name: the crane down to the camp
action: The night sky over the camp, then down past the ridge to the tents: the camera comes to rest on the campfire and the three small figures sitting round it. Smoke and sparks rise from the fire.
Held: three people at the fire, each breathing, hair stirring in a light wind; the flames flicker and the light on them flickers with them.
takes.camera: Take the camera from @Video1: a slow tilt down from the sky that settles on the camp.
takes.keyNote: The three sit exactly where they sit in the second-to-last reference image (the same scene closer): Edric on the ground on the LEFT of the fire, Kira on her crate BEHIND the fire, Sera on her blanket on the RIGHT of the fire. The same look as that image.

takes.name: the three at the fire
action: The three at the fire: Edric on the left stares into the flames; Kira behind the fire studies the map; Sera on the right sits hugging her knees, chin up, looking at the sky.
Edric reaches out with his sword and nudges a log in the fire; sparks rise; he draws the sword back across his knee.
Stillness: Kira's finger taps the map, Sera breathes, the fire flickers on every face.
takes.camera: Low, from the south, as in @Video1: a very slow push in.

takes.name: Sera's look
action: Close on Sera, lit from the left by the fire, looking up at the sky; she takes a slow breath; a faint gold glint shines in her eyes.
Her eyelids close slowly and her eyes come down, away from the sky; one slow blink.
She looks across the fire, very still, her face hiding what she knows. Kira, small behind her, watches.
takes.camera: Close from the south-east: a slow push in.

takes.name: Edric feels her look
action: Close on Edric, lit from the right by the fire: he stares into the flames.
He feels someone looking: his head comes up and turns to the right, toward the other side of the fire.
His eyes meet hers (off screen); he breathes out; the ghost of a tired smile.
He holds the look, then his eyes go back to the fire. Embers drift across the frame.
takes.camera: Close from the south-west: a slow push in.

takes.name: Kira sees him look
action: Close on Kira on the crate, the fire lighting the face: a gloved finger taps the map.
The finger stops; Kira's eyes lift from the map to Edric (off screen left); the ponytail swings.
Kira folds the map shut along its crease.
Still, the map folded on the knee, watching.
takes.camera: Close from the south-east: a slow push in.

takes.name: Edric rises
action: Low and close: Edric sits on the ground by the fire, the sword across his knee; behind him Kira and Sera at the fire.
He puts one hand flat on the ground and pushes; ash and grit puff up where the hand presses.
He rises in one move: a foot under him, up into a crouch, then standing, the sword in his right hand, the cloak swinging and settling.
He stands still and lifts his face to the sky. His boots stay planted; a little dust settles round them.
takes.camera: Take the camera from @Video1: low and close, tilting up with him as he stands, then a smooth pull back and up.
takes.keyNote: Sera is NOT in this frame: she sits further right, out of the picture. Only Edric (large, in the foreground, seated on the ground) and Kira (small, on her crate behind the fire) are visible.

code.what: the Thread across the stars, on the crash (code, as now)
